summary: Waste Connections, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement pursuant to Rule 424(b)(5) on July 27, 2026, for an offering of C$ senior notes due 2033 and 2036. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, offer a change-of-control put at 101%, and are joint-led by CIBC, Scotiabank, and TD with co-managers J.P. Morgan, BofA, and Mizuho. No special-situation event is present.
